_comment: Swing Trade Backtest & Scanner — Master Config File

zerodha._comment: Get enctoken: run get_enctoken.py — it saves here automatically

backtest._comment_dates: Trading signals fire only from start_date. Warmup data downloaded from warmup_days before start_date.
backtest._comment_warmup: Increased to 250 days (~175 trading candles) — needed because 200 EMA now requires 200 candles to be accurate from day 1 of trading.

capital._comment_risk: Max % of capital lost if SL hits. Actual loss = capital × risk_per_trade_pct / 100.
capital._comment_position: Max % of capital per trade. 30% means max ₹1.5L per trade on ₹5L capital. Typical 2-3 simultaneous trades = ₹3-4.5L deployed, comfortably within capital. Rare 5-trade overlap = ₹7.5L — acceptable since it almost never happens due to VIX/ADX filters staggering entries.

stock_selection._comment_blacklist: Intentionally empty — no blacklist. Blacklists require hindsight (knowing which stocks lose in advance). All 50 Nifty stocks traded equally. Rule-based filters (VIX, ADX, 200 EMA, gap) handle bad market conditions without stock-specific bias.

trade_rules._comment_entry: Signal fires after market close. Entry at next day open price.
trade_rules._comment_gap: Skip trade if next day open gaps more than these % vs signal day close.
trade_rules._comment_rr: RR=3.0 performed better than 2.0 in 2014-2019 choppy markets (59% vs 19% ROI). Fewer target hits but each earns significantly more. Trailing stop handles exits beyond target.

exit_rules._comment_be: Move SL to entry once trade reaches 1:1 RR. Zero risk on winner, no extra transaction.
exit_rules._comment_trail: Trail by 1.5x ATR after breakeven triggered.

volatility_filter._comment: Combined VIX + Nifty trend + ADX filter. Blocks NEW entries only — never forces exit on open trades.
volatility_filter._comment_no_entry: VIX >= 18 → no new entries. Demonetisation had VIX spike to 22+ — this alone would have blocked most Nov 2016 entries.
volatility_filter._comment_lookback: 5-day rolling avg VIX to avoid single-day false signals
volatility_filter._comment_50ema: No new entries when Nifty 50 close is below its 50 EMA. Already implemented.
volatility_filter._comment_200ema: NEW — No new entries when Nifty 50 close is below its 200 EMA. Stronger bull market confirmation. 200 EMA is the institutional benchmark — below it = bear territory regardless of short-term bounces. This would have blocked most of 2015 correction and 2018 IL&FS crash entries.
volatility_filter._comment_adx: NEW — ADX (Average Directional Index) measures trend STRENGTH regardless of direction. ADX > 25 = strong trend present. ADX < 20 = choppy/sideways market. We only enter when ADX confirms a strong trend exists on Nifty 50.
volatility_filter._comment_adx_period: Standard ADX period. 14 days is the Wilder default.
volatility_filter._comment_adx_threshold: Raised 25→30. ADX>30 = strong established trend. Blocks more of the 2018 IL&FS crisis period where ADX was 20-25 (weak trend). Higher threshold = fewer but higher quality entries.
volatility_filter._comment_adx_caution: ADX 20-25 = weak trend forming. In this zone, require A-grade rank score (>= adx_caution_min_score) to enter.
